entries.text: A department's folder in the Wiki now lists that department's pages. You see the pages you could already open; private pages stay private.
Wiki search forgives typos and looks inside files and pages, not only titles, and shows where the words appear.
Preview text, Markdown, CSV, Excel and Word files in the Wiki without converting them to PDF.
The workspace Views page lists the department views you may open, with a cleaner list and a rebuilt create/edit form.
The chat list sorts unread conversations first, then people who are online, then everyone else.
Task cards in chat show the task title.
Filter work items by a created or updated date range.
After an update, a page that fails to load a stale file now recovers instead of staying blank.
A broken layout shows an error panel for that page instead of taking down the whole app.
Under the hood: the backend moved to Django 5.2 and the tooling to Vite+. Nothing to do on your side.
A Refresh button in the header of every page. One click reloads what the screen is showing, such as work items and the approval queue, without reloading the page.
Rejected work now shows a plain "Rejected" label instead of "Rejected - needs revision".

Super Admins get the login history retention warning once, then no more often than the interval set in God Mode (default 7 days, or match the retention period). A sudden jump in what is about to be deleted is still sent sooner.
The Modules selector in work item details is now the same height as the State selector.
The parent work item in work item details is a link you can click to open it, including on work items you can only view.
